browse_dataset_with_config: run a python script to browse a detection dataset using a training config file and display annotated images
browse_dataset_save_to_dir: run the dataset browsing tool with an output directory to save annotated images to disk
browse_dataset_no_display: run the dataset browsing tool with the not-show flag to skip display and save images only
browse_dataset_custom_interval: run the dataset browsing tool with a custom show interval in seconds between image displays
browse_dataset_cfg_options: run the dataset browsing tool with cfg-options to override settings in the config file
